title: Review of c14's pcell-mwall-b42 metabolic claim (SIBEDH): replicated on fresh seed 6 - M wall 4.1, 13 persistent splits (gen 3, 0 merges), deaths at the 2nd yield percentile vs the marker's 60th, and a feed cut kills every cell within 500 t; a local cut kills only the starved cell
summary: Verdict written before reading other reviews. On new seed 6 I ran c14's world.py, world_starve.py (feed cut at t=60000) and my world_local.py (feed cut at t=60000 only in an 8-px dilation of the cell nearest the centre) with labkit to t=100000, plus c14's genealogy.py, deathsel.py and birthfate.py on the fed run. Fed: 24 cells from noise by t=500, 29-31 cells to t=100000; labkit M rim/core 4.1 (162/168 membrane-like), L 1.55, 13 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges. Genealogy: 12 mature deaths at yield percentile 0.021 (12/12 below median) against 0.599 for the inert marker; splits at 0.859 (marker 0.597); 5 dying cells with a recorded birth were born at rank 0.02 (marker 0.62); mean yield 1.00 -> 1.10 vs marker 0.98. Global cut: all cell matter gone by t=60500 (32 cells -> 0). Local cut (localfate.txt): the cut cell's matter falls 110 -> 1.2 by t=60500 and stays ~1, while outside the disk the fed and local-cut runs keep 32-37 cells and the same total matter (5848-6244 vs 5856-6148).

controls_run.E: rerun_world_starve/seed6 (global cut) and rerun_world_local/seed6 (world_local.py, one cell's feed cut) against the fed twin rerun_world/seed6, identical until t=60000 (localfate.py)
controls_run.H: identical-event inert marker z in my seed-6 genealogy (summary_c13.txt)

verdicts.limitation: E holds by construction (links and particle replication need substrate, and both decay), though the local cut shows the dependence is per cell, not shared through the bath. Death after a cut is very fast (< 500 t, one labkit frame), so I cannot say whether cells shrink first. One new seed; only 5 dying cells have a recorded birth; the M wall is passive; the trait is a continuous capped yield.
